featured_reviews.review_text: This is a typical sweets and namkeen shop just straight road from Sion BEST bus depot .. (hardly 2 mins) .. one must try hot mouth watering jalebis (prepared in desi ghee) available only in morning.. you can try other namkeen too.. pocket friendly shop..

featured_reviews.review_text:
Really good snacks and farsan shop. Everything from jalebi to farsan mix is tasty delicious. Do try their kachori, samosa, khakhras and bakarwadi. I especially love their khaman dhokla!

The reliable old and kind of only shop to get fresh Nam keen . Their Kachori are very tasty. Also you get hot Jalebis and fafdas is in the morning.
Its old shop and we will get very tasty farsan specifically for kachori jaiswal is famous

featured_reviews.name: Sagar Nayak
featured_reviews.review_text: I tried Jalebi Fafda, and it was delicious. And more than that, the shop owner is also very sweet. I went with my friends for the first time & we were sharing Jalebis there, and when he noticed that 3 of us were sharing 1 plate of Jalebis he gave us some extra later. Truly humble character 🌟🌟

featured_reviews.name: Archana pilinje
featured_reviews.review_text: They provide amazing jalebi and fafda fried in ghee

featured_reviews.name: Bhupen Soni
featured_reviews.review_text:
Seek out these places for an early morning delight that includes crispy, syrupy Jalebis paired flawlessly with savory Fafda. The contrast of sweet and salty, crisp and syrupy, creates a delightful flavor explosion that's sure to tantalize your taste buds.

And for the ultimate Punjabi Samosa experience, make sure to accompany it with a tangy and zesty green chutney.

featured_reviews.name: Nidhi Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
The snacks and farsans at Jaiswal are delicious!
The jalebis are thin and crispy, and the papaya chutney served with it is super yum!
The staff does not wear gloves while packing the farsans which means the food comes in contact with their hand. They must be more mindful about this.

featured_reviews.name: Dr Rituparna Basumatary
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely loved this sweet shop! The sweets are incredibly tasty, especially the barfi and kaju katli — both are just perfect in texture and flavor. I’ve tried many sweet shops, but the quality here really stands out. Definitely a go-to place for anyone who loves authentic, delicious sweets!

featured_reviews.name: Saahil Ledwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Chandu Halwai to pick up 56 Bhog items for Ganpati aarti at home. The variety was impressive, and everything we took turned out fresh and tasty. 🙏✨ It definitely added to the festive spirit.

The sales staff are quite senior but very cooperative and helpful in managing the bulk order, which made the shopping experience smooth.

Overall, a reliable place for traditional sweets and festive offerings. Good taste, good service — worth trying!

featured_reviews.name: Prarthi Pillay
featured_reviews.review_text: I ordered modaks with high expectations, but was extremely disappointed with what we received. The modaks were stale and had a bad smell, making them completely inedible. Very poor quality and absolutely not worth the money. Freshness should be the minimum standard for food items, especially traditional sweets like modaks, and this experience was very upsetting. Definitely not recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Vidyadheesh Upadhye
featured_reviews.review_text:
Chandu Halwai is a 120 year old establishment which serves some lip-smacking traditional Indian sweets, savouries & some bakery items. They have 19 branches across Mumbai.

This outlet is located right in the heart of Sion Circle and is a landmark by itself. By virtue of being located on one of the arterial roads of Mumbai, finding parking is quite a task here.

It does not boast of upmarket and elaborate interiors but does a very good job for which it opens shutters every morning; serving good food.

MUST HAVE;
Malai Sandwich
Phirni
Motichoor Ladoo
Rasmalai

I have tried their bakery items as well and found them to quite good especially the Wheat Toast.

I like the savouries they make especially their Banana chips which is liked by my daughter.

featured_reviews.name: MD Oak
featured_reviews.review_text: Best halwai in town! I love his jalebis 🌼

featured_reviews.name: Dr.Ranjana S
featured_reviews.review_text: Average sweets. Have purchased Besan Ladoo which was okayish...didnt really taste like the ones I've had at other sweet shops. Their moong dal halwa was bad :/ Loads of ghee but no taste. The samosas too were bad for the price. Rs.18 for a small piece that tasted just above average. Not a place I would recommend !

featured_reviews.review_text: Fresh Sweets made by using Ghee are sold here. Hospitality is good.

featured_reviews.name: khan anas zaid
featured_reviews.review_text: It's costly but sweets are fresh and tasty.

featured_reviews.name: swayambharat
featured_reviews.review_text:
Guru Nanak Sweets
Time tested. Been tasting their wonderful offerings over time.. to be precise, relishing since 1972 and still cant have enuf of their supremely crafted “Petha Barfi”.
Normaly Petha is associated with Agra and one can get Petha from various places right from Punjab, Rajasthan and the famous Haldiram Foods from Delhi n Nagpur, but atleast i’ve never had a better combination of saturated sweet Petha titbits floating in a bed of mild Mawa Barfi... the combination is pure Heaven!
Just like their understated Gulab Jamuns- no fancy fillings with dry fruits etc. Pure homemade stuff!
Also the Jeera Puris.. think they are called Matari.. are superb. And ofcourse the Desi Ghee Ladoos!!!
Based in Mumbai in Sion Koliwada, next to Hardeep Punjab and Mini Punjab.. diagonaly opp Hazara Restaurant, one thing for sure... wont go back hungry from here!

featured_reviews.name: Siddharth sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
Small place with gulab jamun which are hot and samosas with sweet chutney.

It's a sinful evening snack joint and you would end up taking parcel for loved ones after finishing your share.

featured_reviews.name: gitanjali banik
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is like nostalgia for me all my birthday sweets my dad always bought from this place. But my recent visit I missed that old warmth of this place.Absolutely unfriendly behaviour.I noticed even the sweets taste was different. I wish they could retain to the old standards.

featured_reviews.name: Sarabjit Kaur
featured_reviews.review_text: Don’t buy any sweets from this shop… they are big time liars… we bought kaju Barfi from them and my mom asked if it was made of peanuts… he said no it was pure made of cashews…he lied straight on our face… later when we tasted the Barfi… we realized that it was actually made of peanuts and it was the most disgusting tasting Barfi ever… we wasted more than 500rs there. Go anywhere else but never here. The sweets are adulterated.

featured_reviews.name: ravi oberoi
featured_reviews.review_text: 3rd Class sweet Shop , Better Visit Guru Kripa sweet Shop(Gupta Aunty), which is hardly 50 meters from here, They charge you too high , No Ghee sweets available, All Prepared in some Pamolein oil which smells like hell, The OLD shop before the building came up was far better , These people have messed up with the AMRITSARI BHRAVAAN DI HATTI attitude, Didn't maintain the Legacy. Dont ever Buy anything from here.

featured_reviews.name: Satinder Singh Arora
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the oldest sweetmeats shop in GTB Nagar, famous for it's Punjabi style sweets & quite reasonable in Price, quality is also Very good, they also make very good Punjabi Samosas, available only in the evening.

featured_reviews.name: Gaurang Gulati
featured_reviews.review_text: Been buying authentic Punjabi Sweets from this shop since years and not a bit of the taste has changed regarding any product, be it the milk cake or the well known matthri... The navigation to the store is quite difficult, like it lies between the Kings Circle and GTB railway station... Walking through the lanes is quite a task in the morning time...

featured_reviews.name: Dalvir Singh Matharu
featured_reviews.review_text:
25 year old customer. Been buying bulk sweets from them for as long as I can remember.
My grandmother just passed away. We brought pinnis from them 50 boxes products worth over 13500/- they showed us a good product and delivered a product that tasted rough and powdery. We tried to talk to them about it. They were very rude and insulting. Tried to tell us that we might have had a change in the program and wanted to give it back. It was hurtsome.
This is how relationships are spoilt.
They forced us to take the product back. We walked out of the store without a refund, boxes or even an apology.
Anyways just an advice. If you buy from them, do so with caution!

featured_reviews.review_text: Jayni’s Sweets delivered exceptional treats for our occasion, making the perfect return gifts. featured_reviews.name: Mayank Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
If You Are Going Here You Need To Try Their Assorted Sweet Box.
You get A Mixture Of All Their Sweets in the Box.
Even After Having No Sugar,No Mawa, Or No Milk the Taste of the Sweets were Really Good.
They Are Healthy And A Perfect Choice for Diwali If You Have Elders In your home and even for you if you are looking for A Healthy And Tasty Alternative To regular Sweets.
I went with their 500gms Assorted Sweet Box But you can also Try Their 250gms Box too.
Jaynis is a Really Good Option for you this Diwali.

featured_reviews.name: Prajakta Vijayakar
featured_reviews.review_text: We had ordered around 40 kg of 80 assorted sweet boxes for Gifting  this Diwali. We received them in proper Gift packing Box and were delivered safely on time. Everyone  liked it and were praising. The sweets are made in pure Desi ghee sugar free and the freshness and texture of the sweets was amazing. I highly recommend their sweets.  Anytime a healthy option who has a sweet tooth. The owner was supportive throughout the entire process till the sweets were delivered.Thank you so much!

featured_reviews.name: Mercy Dcruz
featured_reviews.review_text:
The khajoor barfi has been an absolute daily guilt free pleasure!
The variety, freshness and taste of all the ladoo's are delightful.
It has been such a saviour for my cravings and snacking!

featured_reviews.name: Mit Devaliya
featured_reviews.review_text: We had ordered 500 boxes of sugar free assorted sweets last diwali and it was wonderful experience. This diwali also we have ordered 450 boxes.

featured_reviews.name: Shahad Mogal
featured_reviews.review_text: I faced an issue with my sweet order due to a salesperson’s mistake. I informed the staff, and they responded very respectfully. They corrected the issue immediately and also gave me ½ kg sweets complimentary. This shows they really care about customers. Very satisfied with the service.I'll visit again soon.

featured_reviews.name: Kevin Popat
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sweets cannot be tasty and healthy at the same time ?? I thought so too, but not anymore...

The sweets at Jayni's are made with pure ghee, zero added sugar, and no milk. They are made with dates, which gives them a naturally sweet flavour.

The assorted sweets box is an absolute burst of flavour, with multiple toppings like hazelnuts, walnuts, pecan nuts, macademia nuts, brazilian nuts, apricots, blueberries, rose petals etc.

We have been ordering 60+ boxes every year for diwali corporate gifting. And Manish bhai has been very helpful in fulfilling all the orders in time. Thank you Jayni's !

featured_reviews.name: Rucchi Modi
featured_reviews.review_text: I ordered 60 boxes of mixed Berry's sweet from Jayni's sweets.. the taste and quality was awesome. Infact i m ordering various sweets and dryfruits from them since past many years.. and their service and quality are excellent

featured_reviews.name: Asif Mondal
featured_reviews.review_text: Sweet County Cafe is a quaint spot with an irresistible ambience and even better pastries. The cozy decor, soft lighting, and soothing background music create the perfect atmosphere for a relaxed coffee break. Their selection of freshly baked pastries—flaky croissants, rich brownies, and delicate tarts—are simply delicious, making it hard to choose just one. Paired with their expertly brewed coffee, it’s the ideal place to unwind and indulge. Whether you're meeting friends or enjoying a quiet moment, this cafe hits the sweet spot.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Sweet County @ Sion branch

It was truly a masterpiece - not only it was visually beautiful, but it was also incredibly delicious. Your baking skills are truly impressive, and I'm so appreciative of the time and effort you put into making this special treat, that too only when the order was placed to you over phone n’ via WhatsApp..
Much appreciation to Mr. Mahalingam @ Sion branch who patiently answered all my calls and understood the titbits of the cake design I wanted..
Thank you once again !
I'm so grateful!

💝Pratha Mahendra Gurav

featured_reviews.review_text: I've been an pld old customer here and have ordered more than 10 cakes until now, they've managed to maintain their taste and quality always. featured_reviews.name: Gurvinder Pal Singh Kalra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently ordered from Purshottamm Kandoi Haribhai Damodar Mithaiwala (what a legendary name for a legendary place!) to celebrate the fantastic victory of Mrs. Sheetal Gambhir in the recent BMC elections. As a proud supporter, I wanted something special, authentic, and indulgent to mark the occasion, and this iconic Mumbai sweet shop (since 1952!) delivered beyond expectations. I gave it a perfect 5-star rating on the app, and here’s why it truly deserves every bit of it.
The order included:
•	Vati Dhokla (those fluffy, perfectly steamed yellow cubes with the classic tempering of mustard seeds, curry leaves, and green chilies – soft, spongy, and bursting with tangy flavor)
•	Kothimbir Wadi (fresh, herby coriander-packed slices that were crispy outside and moist inside – a Gujarati classic done to perfection)
•	Healthy Cutlets (surprisingly delicious, packed with nuts and veggies, great texture, and a guilt-free snack option)
•	And the absolute star of the show – Kesar Rasmalai (12 pieces)!
Oh, the Kesar Rasmalai was pure bliss! The spongy chenna balls were soaked just right in thick, creamy, saffron-infused milk – not overly sweet, beautifully aromatic with real kesar strands, and topped with nuts for that premium touch. Each bite melted in the mouth, and the subtle cardamom flavor made it feel luxurious yet comforting. It was hands-down the best rasmalai I’ve had in a long time – fresh, rich, and so delicately balanced.
We enjoyed this delightful spread together at Smartflex Gym (shoutout to the amazing vibe there in Dadar West!), turning our post-workout session into a mini celebration feast. Sharing these treats with friends after a good sweat felt extra rewarding – the savory snacks fueled us perfectly, and the rasmalai was the ultimate sweet victory reward. Everything arrived fresh, well-packaged, and piping hot/cold as needed.
Purshottamm never disappoints with their authentic Gujarati flavors and consistent quality. This order was a complete winner – tasty, hygienic, timely delivery, and full of joy. Highly recommended for any celebration (or just because!). If you’re in Mumbai and craving genuine mithai and farsan, this is the place.
Thank you, Purshottamm, for making our celebration even sweeter! 🏆🍯✨
5/5 stars – will order again and again!
